title: Same knowledge of sensorimotor contingencies, same experience

statements.text: Two systems with the same input-output relations can differ in experience if they differ in mastery, as a person adapted to reversing goggles differs from one who has just put them on. Two systems with the same knowledge of sensorimotor contingencies have the same experience, which requires bodies alike in low-level detail.

sources.quote: Same knowledge of sensorimotor contingencies, then same experience.
For only bodies that are alike in low-level detail can be functionally alike in the relevant ways.
